name: Fingernail Floss
source:
Fingernail Floss is a short horror visual novel made for Horror Game Jam #11!

Following the Game Jam's theme of A Game of Life and Death, a (semi) colorful cast of MS Paint characters are forced to test mobile devices and hope that they can escape in one piece.

[From [url=https://crispyblue.itch.io/fingernail-floss]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
指甲线是一部为Horror Game Jam #11制作的短篇恐怖视觉小说！

遵循Game Jam的“生与死的游戏”主题，一群（半）多彩的MS Paint角色被迫测试移动设备，并希望他们能够连体逃脱。

[来自[url=https://crispyblue.itch.io/fingernail-floss]Itch.io[/url]]
